data.description: Original Protocol J3R-MC-YDAF signed and approved on 09-Sep-2025

Protocol Amendment (a) - nonsubstantial amendment addressing feedback from internal safety committee. Changes include updates to insulin use restrictions in Exclusion Criteria (Section 5.2), Initiation of new Antihyperglycemic Medications (Section 6.9.1), Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.2), and Prohibited Medications (Section 6.9.3). Document ID: VV-CLIN-198891. IND: 158631. EU trial number: 2025-523658-15-00. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly.
